messages:
deploy-bot: Heads-up: planning an unpin of runtime v2.14 on canary in us-west-2 at 2024-06-15T22:00Z. Will route ~5% traffic for 30m. Command: `deploybot unpin runtime v2.14 --canary us-west-2 --pct 5 --dur 30m`
Alex H.: 👍 what's the SDK compatibility matrix for v2.14 -> v2.15? do we need a shim?
Priyanka: There's a known edge with quantized-llama3x where KV cache indexing changed. SDK 1.4.2 needs the runtime shim; without shim we see incorrect token alignment on very long context (>16k).
Matt: Noted. If we unpin and see token-mismatch errors we should auto-rollback to v2.13. What are our detection signals?
Sarah: telemetry: spike in token-reuse errors + embedding drift + 5xx increase on model-serving calls. Can set alert: `metric(token_alignment_errors) > 50 in 5m` to trigger rollback.
Jordan: Also add a quick client-side guard: SDK 1.4.2 should reject opening sessions with runtime v2.14 unless shim applied. We can push a patch to the SDK last-minute if needed.
Alex H.: For the canary window: keep a manual hold (ops) for the first 10m to eyeball logs, then let autopilot. Who's on-call? @Matt you're scheduled?
Matt: Yep I'll be on-call. I'll watch the dashboards and be ready to execute `deploybot pin runtime v2.13 --force` if symptoms show.
Priyanka: Quick checklist for rollout notes: 1) Confirm SDK shim deployment to 1.4.2 clients (opt-in), 2) Add runtime compatibility header to responses, 3) Enable token_alignment telemetry at debug level for canary only.
deploy-bot: Plan acknowledged. Will post follow-up with exact command invocation and rollback playbook ~1h before window.
Sarah: Also update release-notes draft: call out quantized-llama3x caveat and recommended SDK versions. Link to draft: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/drafts/runtime-2-14-unpin-canary
Jordan: If we hit the mismatch, do we prefer gradual pinback or immediate full pin? I'm leaning immediate full pin for safety given downstream embedding clients.
Matt: Immediate full pin (all regions) after meeting threshold, but prefer to attempt canary pinback first for 10m. We'll follow the runbook: canary rollback -> pin rollforward -> postmortem.
Alex H.: Small nit: make sure the deploybot command also adds an annotation so audits show why we pinned back. e.g., `--annotation "token_alignment_spike"`
Priyanka: I'll join the canary watch and validate model outputs with our longseq testset. If I see drift I'll post sample diffs.
Sarah: Sounds good. I'll create the alert and add the dashboard link in the runbook.
deploy-bot: Reminder: tagging @oncall and posting ephemeral instructions in #eng-oncall 10m before.
Matt: Cool. Leave communication channel open in this thread during window. If nothing triggers, we'll proceed to gradual 25% after 6h.
Alex H.: Thanks everyone — feel free to @mention me if you need support for SDK quick patch.
